content.text:
I submitted index 121 (Cr 0.09, Fe 0.59, V 0.31) as the best composition. Its EQE of 0.0687% was the highest of the three I measured under 2.06 eV light. All 3 merit measurements are used, and I used 3 of the 5 XRD measurements.

| Index | Cr / Fe / V | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 121 | 0.09 / 0.59 / 0.31 | **0.0687** |
| 90 | 0.10 / 0.46 / 0.44 | 0.0608 |
| 145 | 0.29 / 0.36 / 0.35 | 0.0426 |

- **Trend:** EQE went up with more Fe and down with more Cr. I used the first two results to choose the third composition, which moved in that direction.
- **Unexplored area:** I never measured anything with more Fe than index 121, such as index 137 (Fe 0.67). The best composition may lie further along that direction, so index 121 is only the best of what I measured, not a confirmed optimum.
- **XRD:** I scanned indices 90, 145 and 40. The strongest peaks in all three appear to come from the tin-oxide substrate. Indices 90 and 145 share the same additional peaks, possibly an iron vanadate. Index 40, which is V-rich, shows different ones. I didn't identify any of these phases, so they did not guide the choices.
